status: Frozen before fixture fitting; previous round23/17 outcomes exposed
scope: Qualify a bounded exact witness/counterexample method for fixed digit-to-1..3letter units with a known CMU lexicon and supplied training-word boundaries. Separately measure hidden test-word boundaries, withheld names, homophonic digit keys, phonetic spelling ambiguity and hidden-vocabulary nonidentifiability. No game fits this round.
lexicon: Reuse pinned round23 normalization; full orthographic bank, excluding the predeclared synthetic-name list from TRAINING lexical constraints. Names remain possible emitted strings at transfer; never require heldout membership in lexicon. Preserve all other CMU names/abbreviations; this is not a grammatical-English model.
generator: 30base keys with10distinct units, six length1/two length2/two length3 sampled from top40frequency pools using the pinned source; at least60encodable non-name forms and one encodable withheld name. Use randomized valid encodings, then freeze one encoding per form. Select7training forms greedily for observed-digit coverage (tie count-distinct,length,lexicographic); require all10digits. Extend to30distinct training forms. Reserve10other forms. Derive a missing-digit condition from the30training forms, choosing a digit whose removal leaves>=7train forms and>=1held form using that digit. Same base key across paired conditions, not independent samples.
homophonic_generator: 30additional keys: start with10distinct units sampled as above, replace the last unit with the first, randomize encodings so both digit aliases can occur, and use the same coverage/training/transfer requirements. Keep them as a distinct scenario, not phonetic spelling disambiguation.
algorithm: Find a first training-compatible key, then search for a counterexample key. SAT supplies a witness, UNSAT certifies uniqueness within the frozen model, budget exhaustion is inconclusive. For each held word compare all emitted chunks; a witness with different form proves form ambiguity; if chunks differ but concatenation agrees, search separately for a differing form. Held values never constrain the key to be lexical.
transfer: 10reserved forms plus all encodable predeclared names for base rich cases. Missing digits remain unknown. Do not pick a word from an unexhausted solution prefix. Names excluded from training bank are scored only after prediction.
boundary_test: 30paired base cases: concatenate reserved raw words in five adjacent pairs without their word spaces. Measure exact lexicon DAGs with cuts allowed only between emitted digit-units. Report oracle-known-key results separately from learned-key results. Do not treat a unique unspaced output string as unique word boundaries.
phonetic_ambiguity: 30new CMU phone forms with>=2spellings and<=10distinct phones. Encode with random injective digit labels and provide the true key to a local decoder. Recover phones; retain all spellings and abstain on unique spelling. This is a known-key diagnostic, not a new phonetic-key learner.
hidden_vocabulary: 30new deterministic digit relabelings of a predeclared two-dictionary boundary counterexample: A=[1234,5678,9012], B=[12345,678,9012]. Training repeats123456789012; both dictionaries prefix-free, same cardinality/length-sum/frequencies, different cuts. Novel12349012discriminates. Verify certificates, not a hidden-vocabulary learning qualification. Do not rerun failed round17 learners as a new method.

gate.required: Complete uniqueness certificates for claims; full-key recovery reported separately. Abstentions count against coverage. Missing-digit/homophone/ambiguous cases have separate safe-abstention checks, not automatic recovery passes.

selection_limits: Vocabulary-conditioned lists and fresh random keys, not natural prose, new authors, or independent observations of Tibia. Thirty paired cases are not thirty independent English sources. Generic hidden-word-boundary key learning and unknown vocabularies remain unqualified unless actually demonstrated.
